---
title: "How a fully grown tree can overfit"
toc: false
page-layout: full
---

The same Gini-split procedure can be allowed to continue until every terminal
region contains observations of only one label. This animation grows a tree on
a slightly more mingled version of the mock dataset from the split explorer,
with no limit on depth, no minimum leaf size, and no required minimum Gini
decrease.

::: {.callout-warning}
## Perfect training fit is not necessarily a good model

The final tree classifies all 16 observations correctly. But notice how it
creates increasingly narrow regions to accommodate individual observations.
That is a sign that the tree is memorizing this dataset and may not generalize
well to new operating points.
:::

<div id="tree-overfit-animation" class="tree-overfit-animation">

<div class="tree-overfit-layout">

<figcaption>
Red triangles are positive labels; green circles are negative labels. The
gold rule is the split added in the current frame; blue rules were selected
earlier.
</figcaption>

<section class="tree-overfit-summary" aria-live="polite">

<p id="tree-overfit-step-text"></p>

<div class="tree-overfit-metrics">

</div>

<h3>Rules selected so far</h3>
<ol id="tree-overfit-rules"></ol>
</section>

<p id="tree-overfit-conclusion" class="tree-overfit-conclusion"></p>
</div>

The remedy is not to abandon trees. Instead, use validation performance to
limit their complexity, for example with <code>max_depth</code>,
<code>min_samples_leaf</code>, or <code>min_impurity_decrease</code>.

[Return to Tree-based models](index.qmd)

<script>
(() => {
  const samples = [
    { id: 1, x1: 0.45, x2: 3.30, label: 0 },
    { id: 2, x1: 0.80, x2: 2.75, label: 0 },
    { id: 3, x1: 1.30, x2: 3.50, label: 0 },
    { id: 4, x1: 2.10, x2: 2.70, label: 1 },
    { id: 5, x1: 2.40, x2: 3.15, label: 1 },
    { id: 6, x1: 2.80, x2: 3.45, label: 1 },
    { id: 7, x1: 3.10, x2: 2.85, label: 1 },
    { id: 8, x1: 3.60, x2: 3.30, label: 0 },
    { id: 9, x1: 0.50, x2: 0.60, label: 1 },
    { id: 10, x1: 0.85, x2: 1.40, label: 1 },
    { id: 11, x1: 1.15, x2: 2.10, label: 0 },
    { id: 12, x1: 1.45, x2: 0.90, label: 1 },
    { id: 13, x1: 1.70, x2: 1.80, label: 1 },
    { id: 14, x1: 2.10, x2: 0.55, label: 0 },
    { id: 15, x1: 2.60, x2: 1.30, label: 1 },
    { id: 16, x1: 3.00, x2: 1.90, label: 0 }
  ];

  const chart = {
    left: 76,
    right: 618,
    top: 32,
    bottom: 404,
    xMin: 0.2,
    xMax: 3.9,
    yMin: 0.2,
    yMax: 3.9
  };
  const rootBounds = {
    xMin: chart.xMin,
    xMax: chart.xMax,
    yMin: chart.yMin,
    yMax: chart.yMax
  };

  const svg = document.getElementById("tree-overfit-svg");
  const status = document.getElementById("tree-overfit-status");
  const title = document.getElementById("tree-overfit-step-title");
  const stepText = document.getElementById("tree-overfit-step-text");
  const leafCount = document.getElementById("tree-overfit-leaves");
  const accuracy = document.getElementById("tree-overfit-accuracy");
  const depth = document.getElementById("tree-overfit-depth");
  const rulesList = document.getElementById("tree-overfit-rules");
  const conclusion = document.getElementById("tree-overfit-conclusion");

  function xPixel(value) {
    return chart.left + ((value - chart.xMin) / (chart.xMax - chart.xMin)) * (chart.right - chart.left);
  }

  function yPixel(value) {
    return chart.bottom - ((value - chart.yMin) / (chart.yMax - chart.yMin)) * (chart.bottom - chart.top);
  }

  function countLabels(observations) {
    const positive = observations.filter((sample) => sample.label === 1).length;
    return { positive: positive, negative: observations.length - positive };
  }

  function gini(observations) {
    if (observations.length === 0) {
      return 0;
    }
    const counts = countLabels(observations);
    const positiveShare = counts.positive / observations.length;
    const negativeShare = counts.negative / observations.length;
    return 1 - positiveShare * positiveShare - negativeShare * negativeShare;
  }

  function legalThresholds(observations, feature) {
    const values = Array.from(new Set(observations.map((sample) => sample[feature]))).sort((a, b) => a - b);
    return values.slice(0, -1).map((value, index) => (value + values[index + 1]) / 2);
  }

  function evaluate(node, feature, threshold) {
    const left = node.samples.filter((sample) => sample[feature] <= threshold);
    const right = node.samples.filter((sample) => sample[feature] > threshold);
    const weightedChildGini =
      (left.length / node.samples.length) * gini(left) +
      (right.length / node.samples.length) * gini(right);
    return {
      node: node,
      feature: feature,
      threshold: threshold,
      left: left,
      right: right,
      decrease: gini(node.samples) - weightedChildGini
    };
  }

  function bestSplit(node) {
    const candidates = ["x1", "x2"].flatMap((feature) => {
      return legalThresholds(node.samples, feature).map((threshold) => evaluate(node, feature, threshold));
    });
    if (candidates.length === 0) {
      return null;
    }
    return candidates.reduce((best, candidate) => {
      return candidate.decrease > best.decrease ? candidate : best;
    });
  }

  function childrenFor(node, split) {
    const leftBounds = {
      xMin: node.bounds.xMin,
      xMax: node.bounds.xMax,
      yMin: node.bounds.yMin,
      yMax: node.bounds.yMax
    };
    const rightBounds = {
      xMin: node.bounds.xMin,
      xMax: node.bounds.xMax,
      yMin: node.bounds.yMin,
      yMax: node.bounds.yMax
    };

    if (split.feature === "x1") {
      leftBounds.xMax = split.threshold;
      rightBounds.xMin = split.threshold;
    } else {
      leftBounds.yMax = split.threshold;
      rightBounds.yMin = split.threshold;
    }

    return [
      {
        id: node.id + "-left",
        path: node.path + " then ≤",
        samples: split.left,
        bounds: leftBounds,
        depth: node.depth + 1
      },
      {
        id: node.id + "-right",
        path: node.path + " then >",
        samples: split.right,
        bounds: rightBounds,
        depth: node.depth + 1
      }
    ];
  }

  function snapshot(leaves, rules, lastRule, finished) {
    return {
      leaves: leaves.slice(),
      rules: rules.slice(),
      lastRule: lastRule,
      finished: finished
    };
  }

  function buildFrames() {
    const root = {
      id: "root",
      path: "root",
      samples: samples,
      bounds: rootBounds,
      depth: 0
    };
    let leaves = [root];
    let rules = [];
    const frames = [snapshot(leaves, rules, null, false)];

    while (true) {
      const options = leaves
        .filter((leaf) => gini(leaf.samples) > 0)
        .map((leaf) => bestSplit(leaf))
        .filter((split) => split && split.decrease > 0);
      if (options.length === 0) {
        frames.push(snapshot(leaves, rules, null, true));
        return frames;
      }

      const selected = options.reduce((best, candidate) => {
        return candidate.decrease > best.decrease ? candidate : best;
      });
      const children = childrenFor(selected.node, selected);
      leaves = leaves.filter((leaf) => leaf.id !== selected.node.id).concat(children);
      rules = rules.concat([{ node: selected.node, split: selected }]);
      frames.push(snapshot(leaves, rules, selected, false));
    }
  }

  function svgElement(name, attributes) {
    const element = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", name);
    Object.entries(attributes).forEach(([key, value]) => element.setAttribute(key, value));
    return element;
  }

  function leafFill(leaf) {
    const counts = countLabels(leaf.samples);
    return counts.positive > counts.negative ? "#fee2e2" : "#dcfce7";
  }

  function drawRule(rule, color, width) {
    const split = rule.split;
    const bounds = rule.node.bounds;
    if (split.feature === "x1") {
      svg.appendChild(svgElement("line", {
        x1: xPixel(split.threshold), y1: yPixel(bounds.yMin),
        x2: xPixel(split.threshold), y2: yPixel(bounds.yMax),
        stroke: color, "stroke-width": String(width), "stroke-dasharray": "9 7"
      }));
    } else {
      svg.appendChild(svgElement("line", {
        x1: xPixel(bounds.xMin), y1: yPixel(split.threshold),
        x2: xPixel(bounds.xMax), y2: yPixel(split.threshold),
        stroke: color, "stroke-width": String(width), "stroke-dasharray": "9 7"
      }));
    }
  }

  function drawPlot(frame) {
    svg.replaceChildren();

    frame.leaves.forEach((leaf) => {
      svg.appendChild(svgElement("rect", {
        x: xPixel(leaf.bounds.xMin),
        y: yPixel(leaf.bounds.yMax),
        width: xPixel(leaf.bounds.xMax) - xPixel(leaf.bounds.xMin),
        height: yPixel(leaf.bounds.yMin) - yPixel(leaf.bounds.yMax),
        fill: leafFill(leaf),
        opacity: "0.84"
      }));
    });

    [1, 2, 3].forEach((tick) => {
      svg.appendChild(svgElement("line", {
        x1: xPixel(tick), y1: chart.top, x2: xPixel(tick), y2: chart.bottom,
        stroke: "#cbd5e1", "stroke-dasharray": "5 6", "stroke-width": "1"
      }));
      svg.appendChild(svgElement("line", {
        x1: chart.left, y1: yPixel(tick), x2: chart.right, y2: yPixel(tick),
        stroke: "#cbd5e1", "stroke-dasharray": "5 6", "stroke-width": "1"
      }));
      const xLabel = svgElement("text", {
        x: xPixel(tick), y: chart.bottom + 30, "text-anchor": "middle",
        fill: "#334155", "font-size": "18"
      });
      xLabel.textContent = tick;
      svg.appendChild(xLabel);
      const yLabel = svgElement("text", {
        x: chart.left - 22, y: yPixel(tick) + 6, "text-anchor": "end",
        fill: "#334155", "font-size": "18"
      });
      yLabel.textContent = tick;
      svg.appendChild(yLabel);
    });

    svg.appendChild(svgElement("line", {
      x1: chart.left, y1: chart.bottom, x2: chart.right + 18, y2: chart.bottom,
      stroke: "#334155", "stroke-width": "2"
    }));
    svg.appendChild(svgElement("line", {
      x1: chart.left, y1: chart.bottom, x2: chart.left, y2: chart.top - 12,
      stroke: "#334155", "stroke-width": "2"
    }));
    const xAxis = svgElement("text", {
      x: chart.right + 30, y: chart.bottom + 8, fill: "#0f172a",
      "font-size": "24", "font-style": "italic"
    });
    xAxis.textContent = "x₁";
    svg.appendChild(xAxis);
    const yAxis = svgElement("text", {
      x: chart.left - 10, y: chart.top - 16, fill: "#0f172a",
      "font-size": "24", "font-style": "italic"
    });
    yAxis.textContent = "x₂";
    svg.appendChild(yAxis);

    frame.rules.forEach((rule) => {
      const isCurrent = frame.lastRule && rule.split === frame.lastRule;
      drawRule(rule, isCurrent ? "#d97706" : "#2563eb", isCurrent ? 4.5 : 3.5);
    });

    samples.forEach((sample) => {
      const x = xPixel(sample.x1);
      const y = yPixel(sample.x2);
      if (sample.label === 1) {
        svg.appendChild(svgElement("path", {
          d: "M " + x + " " + (y - 10) + " L " + (x - 10) + " " + (y + 10) +
             " L " + (x + 10) + " " + (y + 10) + " Z",
          fill: "#ef4444", stroke: "#b91c1c", "stroke-width": "1.2"
        }));
      } else {
        svg.appendChild(svgElement("circle", {
          cx: x, cy: y, r: "10", fill: "#34d399", stroke: "#047857", "stroke-width": "1.2"
        }));
      }
    });
  }

  function trainingAccuracy(leaves) {
    const correctlyClassified = leaves.reduce((total, leaf) => {
      const counts = countLabels(leaf.samples);
      return total + Math.max(counts.positive, counts.negative);
    }, 0);
    return correctlyClassified / samples.length;
  }

  function ruleText(rule) {
    const feature = rule.split.feature === "x1" ? "x₁" : "x₂";
    return rule.node.path + ": " + feature + " ≤ " + rule.split.threshold.toFixed(2);
  }

  function render(frameIndex, frames) {
    const frame = frames[frameIndex];
    const currentStep = frame.rules.length;
    const totalSteps = frames[frames.length - 2].rules.length;
    const deepest = Math.max(...frame.leaves.map((leaf) => leaf.depth));
    const singletonLeaves = frame.leaves.filter((leaf) => leaf.samples.length === 1).length;

    drawPlot(frame);
    status.textContent =
      frame.finished
        ? "Fully grown tree: no impure leaf remains that can be improved by a split."
        : "Growing the tree: split " + currentStep + " of " + totalSteps + ".";
    title.textContent =
      frame.finished
        ? "Every terminal region is pure"
        : currentStep === 0
          ? "Start with one mixed region"
          : "Add rule " + currentStep;
    stepText.textContent =
      frame.finished
        ? "The resulting model has zero training error, but it has created " +
          frame.leaves.length + " local regions to do so; " +
          singletonLeaves + " contain only one observation."
        : currentStep === 0
          ? "The tree has not yet made any rules."
          : "The new gold rule is " + ruleText(frame.rules[frame.rules.length - 1]) + ".";
    leafCount.textContent = String(frame.leaves.length);
    accuracy.textContent = (100 * trainingAccuracy(frame.leaves)).toFixed(1) + "%";
    depth.textContent = String(deepest);

    rulesList.replaceChildren();
    if (frame.rules.length === 0) {
      const item = document.createElement("li");
      item.textContent = "No split yet.";
      rulesList.appendChild(item);
    } else {
      frame.rules.forEach((rule, index) => {
        const item = document.createElement("li");
        item.textContent = ruleText(rule) + ".";
        if (!frame.finished && index === frame.rules.length - 1) {
          item.classList.add("tree-overfit-current-rule");
        }
        rulesList.appendChild(item);
      });
    }

    conclusion.textContent =
      frame.finished
        ? "This is overfitting in miniature: a perfect fit to the observed labels achieved through a mix of broad regions and tiny one-observation regions."
        : "The animation advances automatically and restarts after the full tree is shown.";
  }

  const frames = buildFrames();
  const reducedMotion = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
  let frameIndex = reducedMotion ? frames.length - 1 : 0;
  let timer;

  function play() {
    render(frameIndex, frames);
    if (reducedMotion) {
      return;
    }
    const delay = frameIndex === frames.length - 1 ? 4000 : 1200;
    timer = window.setTimeout(() => {
      frameIndex = (frameIndex + 1) % frames.length;
      play();
    }, delay);
  }

  window.addEventListener("beforeunload", () => window.clearTimeout(timer));
  play();
})();
</script>
